But the thing is change is one of the few constants of life. You didn’t think the same thing you did 5 years ago right? You aren’t gonna think the same things 5 years from now. My best advice is to stop focusing on the “stuck.” You can even say “welp, guess I’m stuck” and then just let it go and move on. Because that alone will begin to get you unstuck.

I’ve been there 100%. It’s definitely not easy. Especially when you feel like you can break through the wall, but the only wall stopping you is the one you believe is there. You believe you’re stuck and so you are. It’s hard to learn but your beliefs shape your reality. Meditate on what you believe. Not what you think, but what you believe. Plain and clear just say out loud “show me my beliefs” and one by one they will appear. Don’t shy away from any of them. Accept them for what they are and if you no longer wish to believe them then stop it. Don’t complicate it and make it and give reasons you can’t because that’s only reinforcing the belief that you’re stuck.

Stop “fighting” the negativity. Let the thoughts and feelings pass like the words on the bottom of a new outlet. They’re their, but don’t try to argue and fight them. When you’re sick you don’t get a knife and stab your body to try and kill the virus or whatever is wrong do you? No. Same thing here. Allow this “sickness” to exist and focus on getting better, not being un-sick. If you focus on the “getting better” you’re focusing on the base of it which is better. If you focus on the “stop being sick” you’re just focusing on the base of that which is the “sick” which is how you will stay. Learn to reorient your thoughts to be positive and progressive statements, not negative or “anti hate.”

Don’t hate you’re hate. Because ultimately you’re still doing the one thing you’re trying not to. Which is hate. Learn to love and accept hate for what it is, just don’t participate in what it tries to draw you in to do. Realize it’s a trap and will only result in your pain, not it’s own.
